_about: Loop MW-0 (docs/design/vision.md 3.9 and 4.4): the 20 then-and-now cards the KASETA tape plays (loop MW-6). The user's answer of 2026-10-29 (vision.md section 10, answer 3): the set covers 2010 to today only. Each card: `id`, `place` (an id in places.json, where the tape button shows within 40 m), `year` (the year the ghost shows, 2010 or later), `line` [pl, en] (the card text, true history, Polish at most 70 characters), `ghost` (English, for the builder: the few boxes the dithered ghost is made of, at most 24; not on screen). No politics, no mockery, no tragedy as a joke.

line: Czerwiec 2012: strefa kibica i wielki ekran. Cały plac śpiewał.
June 2012: the fan zone and a giant screen. The whole square sang.
then_cards.ghost: a big screen on a scaffold frame, a row of white tents, crowd barriers

line: 2020: dźwigi przy Pałacu. Od 2024 roku stoi tu białe muzeum.
2020: cranes beside the Palace. Since 2024 a white museum stands here.
then_cards.ghost: a fenced building site, two tower cranes, a concrete frame two storeys high

line: 2020: Pałac wciąż najwyższy. W 2021 przerosła go nowa wieża.
2020: the Palace is still the tallest. In 2021 a new tower outgrew it.
then_cards.ghost: the new tower to the west as a bare concrete core with a crane, no spire

line: 2010: dźwigi w misie starego stadionu. Dwa lata później Euro.
2010: cranes in the old stadium's bowl. Two years later, the Euro.
then_cards.ghost: the earth bowl's rim, a half-built ring of steel masts, three cranes

line: 2014: na Pragę metrem? Jeszcze nie. W 2015 roku już tak.
2014: the metro to Praga? Not yet. By 2015, yes.
then_cards.ghost: a fenced station dig on Al. Zieleniecka, site huts, barriers

line: 2012: Świętokrzyska rozkopana pod M2. Remont, który się skończył.
2012: Świętokrzyska dug up for the M2. Roadworks that actually ended.
then_cards.ghost: the street closed by site fences and a long trench, a crane, site huts

line: 2017: płot wokół Rotundy. W 2019 wróciła, okrągła jak dawniej.
2017: a fence round the Rotunda. In 2019 it came back, round as before.
then_cards.ghost: a ring of site fence round a bare round roof on posts

line: 2016: kolejka pod pawilonem do świtu. Rok później zapadła cisza.
2016: a queue outside the pavilion till dawn. A year later, silence.
then_cards.ghost: the pavilion lit, a queue of figures along the path, a door lamp

line: 2010: niskie budynki i parkingi. Dziś wieże i orki z laptopami.
2010: low buildings and car parks. Now towers, and orcs with laptops.
then_cards.ghost: the towers removed: low boxes and flat car parks round the roundabout

line: 2011: remont dworca przed Euro. Podróżni szukali wejścia.
2011: the station renovated before the Euro. Travellers hunted for the door.
then_cards.ghost: scaffolding on the hall's glass walls, plywood tunnels at the doors

line: Jesień 2010: ostatnie szlify. 5 listopada drzwi się otworzyły.
Autumn 2010: the final touches. On 5 November the doors opened.
then_cards.ghost: site fence, one crane, the planetarium's sphere as a bare frame

line: 2010: zwykły park pod skarpą. Rok później zatańczyła woda.
2010: a plain park below the escarpment. A year later the water danced.
then_cards.ghost: grass and paths only, the fountain basins absent, a few benches

line: 2014: z hali zostały dwa skrzydła i ściana. Reszta jest nowa.
2014: two wings and one wall were all that was left. The rest is new.
then_cards.ghost: the two side wings and the north arcade wall standing, a crane between

line: 2016: hala czekała na nowe życie. Wróciła we wrześniu 2017.
2016: the hall waited for a new life. It came back in September 2017.
then_cards.ghost: boarded windows, a fence along the front, an empty forecourt

line: 2015: puste hale i komin. Od 2020 roku sklepy i jedzenie.
2015: empty halls and a chimney. Since 2020, shops and food.
then_cards.ghost: the brick halls dark, the yard fenced, no terraces

line: 2014: brzeg i droga, zero schodków. Bulwary rosły od 2015.
2014: a bank and a road, no steps at all. The boulevards grew from 2015.
then_cards.ghost: the steps removed: a grassy bank, bushes, a plain road by the water

line: 2018: pierwsze hulajnogi na minuty. Od razu się położyły.
2018: the first rent-by-the-minute scooters. They lay down at once.
then_cards.ghost: three scooters lying on the promenade in a row

line: Sierpień 2012: ruszyły rowery miejskie. Kolejka po rower, nie po kawę.
August 2012: the city bikes started. A queue for a bike, not for coffee.
then_cards.ghost: a dock of the first season's bikes and three waiting figures

line: 2024: kolejki po czekoladę z pistacją. Tydzień później po coś innego.
2024: queues for pistachio chocolate. A week later, for something else.
then_cards.ghost: a long queue down Chmielna, one figure in five holding a phone up

line: 2015: wszyscy piją latte. Dziś wszystko jest zielone.
2015: everyone drinks lattes. Now everything is green.
then_cards.ghost: the café's fascia in brown, two tables outside, no green cup sign
